placements.title: Signed release manifest gates Meridian deploys
placements.theme: Every Meridian deployment to staging or production requires a signed release manifest before it ships.
placements.why: src-1 and src-3 declare the signed release manifest as the standing gate for Meridian deploys; src-4 scopes the gate to staging and production; src-5 names its owner; src-2 supplies the motivating incident (unsigned artifacts in staging). Together they name one thematic subject—the Meridian signed-manifest deployment gate—not a one-time fact, so a single narrative leaf is the right grain.
